postings.title: Director, Engineering, AI Search
postings.description:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.
 

About the Team

Algolia’s Engineering team builds the core infrastructure and product features that power real-time search and discovery for thousands of customers around the world. This includes backend services, frontend components, site reliability, and ML-powered capabilities. The team is distributed, collaborative, and committed to technical excellence and continuous learning.

As an Engineering Director, you will lead multiple teams or a critical product area, working closely with Engineering Managers, Product, and Design to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-impact solutions. You will play a key role in translating company strategy into execution, while building strong, autonomous teams and fostering engineering excellence.

Your Role Will Consist Of:

  • Leading a group of engineering teams (via Engineering Managers and Senior ICs), ensuring alignment with product and company priorities
  • Demonstrates strong AI leadership within the engineering organization by fostering a culture of continuous improvement and proactively evaluating and applying emerging AI technologies to enhance productivity, efficiency, and organizational performance across the broader technology function.
  • Owning delivery, execution, and operational excellence for a defined product or platform area
  • Partnering closely with Product, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape roadmaps and ensure successful delivery of customer value
  • Driving engineering best practices across system design, scalability, reliability, and performance
  • Being a member of Algolia’s senior technology leadership team, with significant contributions to engineering excellence and the high performance of the global technology organization, extending beyond the immediate area of responsibility.
  • Supporting and coaching Engineering Managers, helping them grow as leaders and build high-performing teams
  • Contributing to organizational planning, including headcount, team structure, and quarterly/annual planning cycles
  • Ensuring a strong culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement within your organization
  • Acting as a bridge between strategy and execution, translating high-level goals into clear team-level priorities
  • Serves as a trusted advisor to the CTO and SVP Engineering, providing strategic guidance on engineering leadership, organizational effectiveness, and cross-functional management initiatives across the technology organization.

You Might Be a Fit If You Have:

  • 8–12+ years of engineering experience, including 3–5+ years managing multiple teams or managing through managers
  • Proven experience delivering complex, cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Strong technical background with experience in distributed systems, APIs, and scalable infrastructure
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through others, empowering managers and senior engineers
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to align diverse stakeholders and drive clarity
  • Experience operating in distributed or global engineering environments

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in developer tools, infrastructure, or data platforms
  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) environments
  • Exposure to AI/ML-powered products or platforms

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.<

You will architect and prototype state-of-the-art AI and technical solutions on the Celonis platform, demonstrate their business impact to C-suite Executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption, and value realization.

You will execute technical discovery, allowing you to prototype and build bespoke, state-of-the-art AI solutions that precisely target nuanced, industry-specific operational pain points.

Requires a proven background in accountable PoV execution, ROI/TCO modeling, and showcasing the "Art of the Possible" by pitching visionary solutions to hidden problems.
  • Domain & Industry Expertise: Solid knowledge of core business processes and industry landscapes (e.g., supply chain, finance). Ability to speak the language of business leaders and connect operational bottlenecks to strategic AI solutions.
  • Software/Data Engineering: Python proficiency, API design, SQL, data integration, and ML/AI libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Hugging Face Transformers).
  • Agentic AI Systems: Hands-on experience with agentic AI setups including LLM orchestration, tool use/function calling, RAG, agents, prompt engineering, or agentic patterns for enterprise workflows.
  • Production ML/LLMOps: Experience with model deployment, monitoring, MLOps/LLMOps, and lifecycle management across cloud services (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, GCP Vertex AI).
  • AI Architecture & Security: Understanding of cloud reference architectures, identity and access, data governance, privacy, and compliance.
  • Math & Operations Research: Applied knowledge of linear/nonlinear optimization, statistical analysis, reinforcement learning, and forecasting is a plus.
  • Strong presentation skills to both internal and external stakeholders (including executives), whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos. Flawless English with exceptional executive presence. Fluent in Dutch would be a preference but not essential. 
  • Degree: Masters Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, business engineering, business information or related fields , or equivalent work experience preferred.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Head of IT Platform & Infrastructure leads one of the core teams of our Global IT organization and reports to the Head of IT Infrastructure. The team owns the platforms almost every Celonaut works in every day — Google Workspace, Atlassian, Slack, and a long tail of business-critical SaaS applications — as well as a deliberately lean, fully cloud-based infrastructure with no legacy data center to maintain.

You lead a distributed team of platform engineers across Europe and India and work side by side with our IT Identity & Endpoint and IT 1st Level Support teams and in very close alignment with InfoSec. Security and identity are shared design principles here, not downstream review steps.

The Role:

This role owns the strategy, operation, and evolution of Celonis' internal platform landscape. You set the direction for how our collaboration and productivity platforms are run, governed, and simplified, and you make sure they stay reliable, secure, and easy to use for a fast-moving global company. You take full ownership of our Atlassian Cloud estate and run it to the same standard as any other production platform.

We are explicitly looking for a leader with a strong AI skillset and mindset: someone who treats AI as a core engineering capability, uses it to remove manual toil from platform operations, and can explain both its value and its risks credibly to leadership. This is a hands-on leadership role. You are close enough to the technology to earn your team's trust and senior enough to set direction, own the budget, and say no.

The work you’ll do:

  • Lead, coach, and grow a distributed team of platform engineers; hire, develop careers, and build a genuine ownership culture with clear responsibilities per platform and no single points of knowledge
  • Define and own the roadmap for our SaaS platforms, AI enablement, and supporting infrastructure; align it with the IT strategy and business priorities and communicate trade-offs clearly to leadership
  • Act as the accountable service owner for our core SaaS platforms — Google Workspace, Slack, and further business-critical applications — covering availability, change and release management, admin standards, and documentation
  • Take full ownership of our Atlassian Cloud platform (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence): administration, governance, performance, and configuration standards that scale as usage across the company grows
  • Use AI actively to change how the team works — automating operational routine, ticket and incident triage, provisioning, reporting, and documentation instead of scaling headcount
  • Drive platform governance: tenant configuration, admin roles, data retention, external sharing, and the approval of third-party apps and integrations
  • Simplify and right-size our application landscape; consolidate overlapping tooling and retire what is no longer needed
  • Own data protection for our SaaS platforms, including the rollout and operation of enterprise backup and recovery
  • Keep our lean cloud infrastructure and core services such as DNS and certificates reliable and secure
  • Own the integration layer between platforms: APIs, event-driven workflows, and automated provisioning, together with the IT Identity & Endpoint team
  • Work in close, continuous alignment with InfoSec; embed least privilege, hardened baselines, and useful logging into platform design, own remediation of findings, and provide reliable audit evidence

The work is both fundamental and applied: you publish, and your models reach products used by doctors and patients. Doctolib is used by around 450,000 health professionals and 90 million people across Europe, and research that succeeds in the lab can be deployed at that scale.

Working at Doctolib means contributing to one of Europe's leading health-tech companies, and seeing your work improve care for patients and practitioners.

Doctolab is a research lab in its founding phase, so researchers have real influence over its direction and its priorities. We work closely with the data science and product teams, and we stay close to the data.

We expect researchers to explain why a question matters, not only why it is open. Projects are chosen on both scientific ambition and what they change for patients and practitioners. The work suits researchers who want to see their results used.

The questions we raise are open problems in machine learning: world models that predict the consequences of an action, calibration and uncertainty, causal inference from observational data, multimodal sequence modelling, orchestration between model capabilities. Results on these questions hold well beyond healthcare. We are in a strong position to work on them: we have the data to learn a world model from, a clinical use case that defines success, and the engineering path to put it in front of practitioners and patients and learn from what comes back.

Experience with healthcare or medical data is a plus but not required. Both early-career and experienced researchers are welcome.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build a world model of patient health: how a health state evolves over time and changes in response to care, learned from observational data with the confounding accounted for
  • Build evaluation methods that test calibration, robustness, interpretability, privacy, and generalization outside the training distribution
  • Work with the data science and product teams to turn research results into clinical-grade features
  • Publish at leading machine learning and health informatics venues
  • Engage the international health and machine learning community through open collaboration: data challenges, shared benchmarks, and open-source releases
  • Help define the lab's research agenda and its working relationship with the rest of the company

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have a PhD in machine learning, statistics, computer science, or a related field, or a Master's degree with significant research experience
  • Have depth in one or more of: representation learning and self-supervised learning; large language models and multimodal modelling; causal inference and causal discovery from observational data; temporal and dynamic modelling; calibration and uncertainty quantification; agentic systems and orchestration; evaluation and benchmarking; privacy auditing of machine learning models
  • Have first-author publications at leading venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or comparable medical informatics venues
  • Have driven your own research, from choosing the question to publishing the result
  • Are proficient in Python and a deep learning framework such as PyTorch, and have trained models yourself

postings.description:
Rejoignez une équipe technique de 9 personnes, spécialisée dans l'interopérabilité entre Doctolib et les logiciels métier des structures Salaried & Retail. Vous contribuerez directement à l'amélioration de l'écosystème de santé en facilitant les échanges de données entre les différents systèmes, tout en participant à l'intégration de l'IA et de l'automatisation dans nos processus.

 

Vos missions

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

  • Participer à la mise en place de connecteurs API utilisant les formats HL7, JSON et FHIR avec les logiciels métier des hôpitaux, centres de santé, centres d'imagerie et magasins d'audio/optique
  • Créer et paramétrer des assistants IA en développant des prompts complexes pour automatiser les processus techniques
  • Contribuer aux travaux d'automatisation de l'équipe en utilisant Python et les technologies d'IA
  • Mettre à jour les processus et la documentation technique pour optimiser les workflows de l'équipe
  • Apporter un support technique aux équipes internes sur les questions d'interopérabilité

 

Les qualités attendues pour ce poste

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos besoins, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si :

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en école d'ingénieur ou en informatique avec une appétence pour les technologies de santé
  • Vous maîtrisez Python et avez des connaissances en intelligence artificielle et machine learning
  • Vous avez une bonne compréhension des API REST et des architectures de systèmes distribués
  • Vous possédez des compétences en gestion de projet et savez travailler en équipe
  • Vous faites preuve de curiosité technique et d'autonomie dans vos apprentissages

Ce serait fantastique si :

  • Vous avez des connaissances de base en standards HL7 et FHIR utilisés dans le secteur de la santé
  • Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des projets d'automatisation ou d'intégration de systèmes
  • Vous avez une expérience avec les outils de développement collaboratif (Git, CI/CD)

postings.title: Workday Integration & Analytics Engineer - Paris (x/f/m)
postings.description:
Doctolib is looking for a Workday Integration & Analytics Engineer to join its People Systems & Performance (PSP) team. You will own the data and integration layer of Doctolib's HR tech stack and reporting capabilities in Workday. You will design and maintain integrations across all HR systems, and drive the team's upskilling on integration competencies. 

Reporting to the HRIS Tech Lead, you will work in close partnership with People Strategy, Finance, Social Impact, Hiring, Onboarding teams, and the Doctolib Data team. You will play a key role in making HR data actionable for decision-making, while ensuring seamless data flows across platforms including Workday, Payroll tools (ADP), other HR and IT integrations, and future solutions.

This role goes beyond traditional WD reporting and integration. You will be the integration architect for the HR ecosystem — designing connectors, APIs, and data pipelines, collaborating with the Data team and other IT teams, exploring AI-powered automation (DUST our main internal IA platform, Workday AI Agents, MCP, WD Extend), and mentoring the team on integration best practices.

You own also fully one functional scope of a Workday module (between Compensation & Advanced Compensation, or Absence, Time Tracking), performing configuration and unit testing (autonomously for basic configuration, relying on external integrator for complexes ones), assessing impacts and being responsible of alignment with business stakeholders.

What you'll do

Workday Analytics & Reporting

  • Own the full Workday reporting layer: standard reports, custom reports, calculated fields, dashboards, and advanced analytics
  • Build and maintain People analytics capabilities and deliver complex reportings for strategic decisions (ex. of KPIs headcount, attrition, performance trends, compensation benchmarks)
  • Ensure data quality and governance across Workday reports in alignment with HR data standards

Integration Architecture & Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain all integrations between Workday and the HR ecosystem (ADP Decidium, ADP Celergo, Ashby, Sana, PeopleDoc, Peakon, and future platforms) and also key point of contact for integration with non HR tools
  • Own the integration architecture: APIs, middleware connectors, Workday Studio, Cloud Connect, and Boomi in collaboration with the Delivery Factory
  • Ensure integration monitoring, incident management, and quality standards across the data layer
  • Key contributor to the PeopleData Hub architecture — coordinating closely with business stakeholders and the Doctolib Data team — to design the central data flow layer connecting HR systems to downstream consumers (Finance, BI, Payroll)

AI & Automation (Workday AI Agents, DUST/MCP)

  • Explore and prototype Workday AI Agents capabilities for HR process automation (self-service, proactive insights, L1 deflection , extension with WD Extend capabilities)
  • Contribute to the Workday-MCP use case  — APIs are available, use cases to define
  • Collaborate on DUST integration with Workday to enable AI-powered HR self-service
  • Evaluate build vs. buy vs. integrate on AI tooling for the HR stack

Team Upskilling & Knowledge Sharing

  • Elevate the team's integration capabilities through documentation, hands-on workshops, and shared architecture standards
  • Build runbooks and integration playbooks that enable autonomous operation and handover to operational teams
  • Act as the go-to expert on integration patterns within PSP

Who you are

Before you read on — if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next teammate if you have:

  • 6+ years of Workday experience, including hands-on Workday reporting and at least one full integration implementation
  • Proven integration architecture experience: Workday Studio, Cloud Connect, APIs (REST/SOAP), or equivalent middleware
  • Experience with HR data flows: payroll integrations (ADP, Deel), benefits/LMS connectors
  • Strong data modeling and governance mindset — you understand the HR data model and its downstream impacts
  • Exposure to AI tooling in an HR context (Workday AI Agents, chatbots, agentic workflows, DUST, or similar)
  • Functional expertise in at least one Workday module: Compensation & Advanced Compensation, or Absence & Time Tracking 
  • Ability to work autonomously in a lean team with direct ownership and minimal process overhead
  • Fluency in French and English (working language is English; stakeholders are multi-country)

Doctolib is looking for you to join our Patient Marketing team in Berlin as a Working Student in B2C SEO and AI Search (x/f/m)

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. 

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

postings.title: Data Analyst II
postings.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

Payment Intelligence

Our mission is to make GoCardless the best way to pay and be paid. Our ambition is to dramatically improve payment performance and safeguard our customers from bad outcomes like payment fraud and failures. You will help find data opportunities and areas to improve our payment intelligence products. You should be comfortable with large data sets, customer data, and machine learning principles. You’ll work alongside Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists in our two core Payment Intelligence teams to provide critical insights and help drive product direction.

Our existing Payment Intelligence Products are already one of the key reasons why customers choose GoCardless. These include Protect+, which defends customers from fraud, and Success+, which helps customers intelligently recover failed payments. You will need to own our understanding of these products and identify insights and opportunities to help us develop new intelligent features.

 

What You'll Do

At GoCardless analytics is at the core of everything we do and drives business performance through data insight. You will play a critical role partnering closely with stakeholders across the business (including product, operations, marketing, and commercial teams) in order to deliver actionable insights to influence decisions at every level of the organisation. The role is focussed on identifying value and driving change throughout the business derived from insights. Your insights will be turned into actions that will help drive the future of GoCardless. You will act as the bridge between the data, technical and business stakeholders informing strategic plans and will own and evolve a suite of reports designed to give a wide range of stakeholders access insights. 

  • Own and iterate on experiments to generate user insight and drive business metrics, allowing the team to quickly take action on business opportunities.
  • Define how we quantitatively evaluate success, setting KPIs, designing tracking to measure what really matters, delving into the leading indicators of user behaviour
  • Influence the organisation to increase Product Data coverage and implement user tracking best practices - acting as a mentor to guide other members of the organisation to become data driven
  • Build models of user-segmentation, customer lifetime value etc in order to inform strategic product & commercial decisions
  • Continuously innovate on the practices and the tools we rely on to deliver the right insights at the right decision points (A/B Testing, Analysis (SQL), Visualisation (Looker), Tracking (Amplitude), Automation (Python), AI (Gemini)

 

What Excites You

  • Become a strategic partner and advisor for the business: you like to proactively seek out gaps in our product capabilities, suggest areas of improvement based on tangible data, as well as owning processes to run and improve testing from the tracking point of view when developing new features. 
  • Act as a catalyst for change across the organization, driving the evolution of our data analytics standards, internal processes, and overall product data strategy to ensure scalability and operational excellence.
  • Translate complex technical findings into compelling, high-impact narratives. You will bridge the gap between technical data and commercial strategy, influencing product roadmaps and executive decision-making across the entire organization.
  • Stay current with AI and data trends to solve real-world problems. You like to leverage these technologies to enhance the payment experience, as well as to optimize data analysis, and deliver high-impact insights and strategic recommendations across th

postings.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

Data at GoCardless 

You'll sit in our Data and Business Systems group, working with technical and non-technical people across the whole company. You'll be part of a collaborative data engineering team, working closely with analytic engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver data solutions that scale with our rapidly growing business.

We're a large team with an extensive remit, and we expect every member to work with initiative and be driven — holding each other accountable and to a high standard. Joining our team, you'll work alongside people who strive to be the best they can be, on complex projects across GC's data and business systems stack.

Our technologies: We endeavour to build simple, reliable systems, and we believe in using the best technology for each task. Technologies we use across GoCardless include Python, Google Cloud Platform, dbt, Airflow, BigQuery, and others.

You're not expected to have expertise in all of these — most of our team have picked up tools once they've started working with us.

The Role

We are looking for a talented Data Engineer to help us build and maintain robust, scalable, and efficient data infrastructure - from ingesting data from third-party sources, to the pipelines and orchestration that move our data, to the models that shape it.

Working closely with analytic engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders, you'll help transform raw data into valuable insights that drive business decisions.

We're hiring across a range of experience levels - from engineers developing pipelines and models independently, through to those leading the design of larger, higher-scope systems.

The main elements of this role will involve:

  • Data modelling and pipeline development: Design, develop, and iterate data models and schemas, and build ETL/ELT pipelines to process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.
  • Data infrastructure development: Implement and maintain scalable data architectures and pipeline orchestration (scheduling, dependencies, retries) using cloud technologies, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Data quality and governance: Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and validation processes to ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems.
  • Collaboration and delivery: Work closely with engineers, data scientists, AI/ML engineers, analysts, and business teams across the company to understand requirements and deliver data solutions that meet their needs.
  • Technical innovation: Stay current with emerging data technologies and best practices, proposing and implementing improvements to our data infrastructure and processes.
  • Documentation and knowledge sharing: Create and maintain technical documentation, share knowledge with team members, and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Be a reflection of the GC Values that help us work with one another effectively.

Who we're looking for

You'll enjoy this role if:

  • You're passionate about working with data at scale and solving complex data challenges - whether that's shaping how data is modelled, how it moves, or how reliably it's delivered.
  • You write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, and care about getting the details right.
  • You enjoy collaborating across diverse teams, and can translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • You think critically and solve problems methodically - debugging complex data issues and optimising system performance.
  • You take ownership of your work, proactively looking for ways to improve it.
  • You're eager to l

postings.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

Riga is a key engineering hub for GoCardless, an important stand-alone hub with over 200 people. All of the core Connectivity group is based there, the team that builds and runs every bank debit and open banking connection we offer, owning the full problem space end to end: build, operate, on-call and incident management, the same way any of our other groups do. 

We need someone to do three main things: ensure Connectivity delivers as a core group, responsible for all core banking connections and file submissions, managing billions of pounds in submissions every month, work that has to run flawlessly, every day; be the engineering site leader for Riga, working with local leadership to make the office a destination for people; and help advocate for and hire in Riga, working with grassroots training schools and communities to make GoCardless a destination for local talent.

What excites you 

  • Owning the roadmap - strategically plan our reliability and future delivery with other senior leaders, while prioritising technical investment with a clearly articulated ROI.
  • Shaping a growing hub - genuine scope to shape what Riga becomes next: how Connectivity operates at scale, and how we attract, grow and retain local talent.
  • Embracing change - you have a growth mindset, open to new ideas and change, while staying committed to focus and speed.
  • Cutting through the complexity - you're a self-starter who can take ambiguous problems that may be outside your experience and apply first principles thinking and reasoning to decompose, hypothesise, test, execute and deliver.
  • Being customer obsessed - you focus on the outcomes and impact for customers in the work we deliver.
  • Delivery - you thrive on getting things done, and on enabling those around you to get more done.
  • Being a player-manager - you can deep dive into technical problems and future architecture, and earn the respect of senior engineers along the way.
  • Excellence - you recognise the importance of building a high-performance engineering culture, and have a view on how to get there.

What excites us  

  • Experience of building and managing agile teams or departments of 20+ people, including managing both managers and individual contributors up to Principal level.
  • Experience of working at scale, where security and operational excellence are critical to success.
  • Delivery - someone who ensures project work is delivered, estimates are accurate, time is tracked and velocity is measured and used to improve the team.
  • Clear communication - concise, regular communication to a leadership team, often non-technical, on progress against strategy and team objectives.
  • A strategic mindset - comfortable tackling long-term roadmaps and our longer-term problems and vision.
  • Comfortable being based in our Riga office; this isn't a remote role.

Base salary range: €97,600 - €146,400

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

  • Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated suppor

Platform Engineering at GoCardless

The Platform Engineering team is a unified, globally distributed team. We are currently located in London, Riga, and Lisbon.

We work with all other engineering teams to empower them to build, release, run and scale their products.

We operate with a strong focus on both strategic project delivery and operational excellence.

Our work is a balance of:

  • Project Delivery: Building new platform components, from initial design to deployment.
  • Operational Support: Ensuring the health and stability of our systems through on-call rotations and incident management.
  • Business as Usual (BAU): Continuous maintenance, improvements, and support for audits and compliance.

Tech stack and tools:

  • Python, Ruby, Golang;
  • Terraform;
  • Atlantis 
  • AWS, GCP;
  • Kubernetes, GKE;
  • Github, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD;
  • Grafana, Prometheus;
  • Datadog

What excites you:

We use a wide range of technologies, and will never expect you to have experience with all of them. We do hope that you are enthusiastic about the infrastructure space and the impact your work can have on others. To enjoy this work you’ll be excited by:

  • Building and maintaining automation of new and existing infrastructure;
  • Appreciate and believe in building easy-to-understand and maintain tools to solve problems;
  • Automating operational tasks to eliminate toil using your software development skills and experience;
  • Ensuring that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats;
  • Working closely with software engineers and data scientists;
  • Being involved in the technical design of architecture and making technical decisions;
  • Cloud-first engineering;
  • Ongoing opportunities to further develop your skills;
  • Care about working with people who share the same values as you and who will continually push you to grow.

What excites us

postings.title: Compliance and Prevention Associate (Complaints Management)
postings.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Compliance & Prevention Associate to join our Complaints Management & Prevention team on our journey to bring N26 Operations to the next level. Reporting directly to the  Complaints Compliance & Prevention Manager, you will serve as the operational engine executing regulatory remediation deliverables, conducting deep-dive Root Cause Analyses (RCA), performing data population reconciliations, and enforcing compliance checks on complaint handling output across all of our markets with focus on Germany.
 

What You Will Do

  • Remediation Execution: Crucial role in audit findings compliance and remediation, working directly with auditors, remediation teams and management to assure timely delivery of projects and initiatives. 

  • Compliance Maintenance: Draft and update Written Orders (SfOs), Work Instructions, process maps, and operational guidelines to resolve open regulatory action items.

  • Case-Level RCA Investigations: Perform deep-dive case investigations across different complaints’ markets to identify underlying technical, process, or operational root causes rather than surface-level symptoms.

  • Audit Evidence Compilation: Collect, verify, structure, and archive Test of Design (ToD) and Test of Effectiveness (ToE) evidence packages for internal and external control reviews.

  • Quality & Output Compliance: Support qualitative and quantitative compliance verification on complaint output, validating SLA calculations, delay communication triggers, and conflict-of-interest checks.


What You Will Bring

  • Minimal requirements: 

    • 4+ years of proven experience in compliance controls, assurance, banking operations or complaints management in German financial space, 

    • full working proficiency in German language.
       

  • Background & Experience: professional experience in consulting, assurance functions, financial regulation, banking quality assurance, or audit support.

  • Functional & Technical Knowledge: Practical understanding of the complaint lifecycle under BaFin MaBeschwer, PSD2, and MaComp standards. Solid working experience with case management and data analysis.

  • Analytical Depth: Strong capability to conduct root cause investigations, trace data discrepancies across multi-system environments, and produce clear, structured process documentation.

  • Languages: Fluent English required as well as professional working proficiency in German. 

 

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most innovative banks 🚀.

  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses. 

  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.


Who we are?
N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1,500 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Vienna and Barcelona.

postings.title: Data Analyst - Everyday Banking
postings.description:
Summary

 We are seeking an organised and self-motivated Data Analyst to work embedded in our Everyday Banking team, to help shape the development of one of the world's leading FinTech products.

About the opportunity

As a Data Analyst (Product) you will enable our product and business segments (Cards, Payments in the Everyday Banking domain to make data-driven decisions. You will monitor, measure and analyse the effectiveness of your product teams’ initiatives, as well as help drive the strategy of your business segment. You are here to establish a data-mindset and thereby to foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. You will work in a cross functional setup, working closely with other analysts, engineers, designers, and product managers.

In this role, you will: 

  • Help us set the right goals: Develop clear and measurable targets based on an initiatives’ scope. Improve our overall forecasting and goal setting capabilities. 

  • Handle stakeholders: Be an internal go-to-person for your teams when it comes to data related questions. 

  • Evaluate initiatives: Support Product experimentation & A/B testing initiatives; design test plans, obtain cross-functional alignment, execute robust analysis, and deliver actionable insights. Share these learnings through clear documentation and concise and empathic communication.

  • Contribute to self-serve data platform: Help building the right analytics foundations ,by pairing up with technical peers, so our product and business teams can interact with data and extract the right insights themselves. 

  • Provide monitoring tools: Build the dashboards your team looks at every week to make sure they are impacting our company OKRs. 

  • Improve data literacy of organisation: Educate teams to become independent when it comes to data access and understanding function led training and team wide workshops to foster data driven culture.

  • Be part of our data-community: Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.

  • Support some of the following product & business team initiatives (not limited to): 

    • You support your team in discovery of new product ideas, identifying user friction points, business opportunities and defining success metrics and targets.

    • Evaluate your teams’ continuous releases making sure they are delivering on business goals via experimental or observational methods.

    • Collaborate with UX researchers to combine qualitative and quantitative research for better product hypotheses.

    • During product development you make sure all data needed for future evaluation is being captured through set up of tracking events or as part of the backend service.

    • Design, conduct and analyze A/B tests 

    • Drive the quantitative analysis on your segment, being responsible for the insights and business discovery on the team.

What you need to be successful:

Background: 

3+ years of experience, ideally within the Product or Analytics field. 

Skills:

  • Strong understanding of statistical methods used in the analysis of experimental and observational data

  • Strong problem solving skills and is comfortable doing exploratory data analysis that generates insights and “so whats”

  • Highly experienced with SQL and Python/R for analytics

  • Experience working with one or more common data visualisation tools (Tableau, Metabase, Looker, Superset, etc)

  • Good presentation skills and communication skills.

  • Experience with A/B Testing & Product Analytics

  • Having experience with cards y/or payments domains in high growth startups would be a big plus

  • Having experience in quantitative research would be a plus

  • Having experience in fintech would be a plus

  • Having experience with AI Analytics would be a plus

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors.

postings.title: IT Solutions Engineer - Google Cloud
postings.description:
About the opportunity

As an IT Solutions Engineer (Google Cloud) within N26 Internal IT, you will be the primary architect, engineer, and guardian of our Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) corporate ecosystem.

We aren’t looking for traditional system administrators. We need a modern, engineering-focused professional who treats our Google environment as a programmable platform. You will bridge the gap between corporate productivity, identity management, and cloud infrastructure—ensuring our global workforce is secure, highly automated, and empowered by next-generation AI integrations.

In this role, you will:

  • Infrastructure & Governance: Manage the full lifecycle of our enterprise Google Workspace organization. Design and maintain complex GCP project structures, organizational units (OUs), Cloud Identity, and Chrome Enterprise across the company.

  • Automation & Development: Eliminate manual overhead by building robust, custom automation workflows. Leverage Google Apps Script, Python, and REST APIs to seamlessly integrate Workspace with internal tools, HRIS platforms, and Identity providers.

  • Next-Gen Productivity: Lead the rollout, adoption, and ongoing optimization of Gemini Enterprise, driving organizational productivity through emerging AI capabilities.

  • Security & Compliance: Design and enforce Data Loss Prevention (DLP) rules, Context-Aware Access (CAA), and secure BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) policies that balance "Security first" with "Employee Experience."

  • eDiscovery & Compliance: Serve as the technical owner for Google Vault. Define and manage data retention policies, execute precise legal holds, and lead matter-based exports to meet strict financial regulatory and audit requirements.

What you need to be successful:

  • Google Workspace & GCP Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience administering Google Workspace at an enterprise scale, combined with solid foundational knowledge of GCP (IAM hierarchies, Service Accounts, VPCs, and Organization Policies).

  • Automation Mindset: Proven track record of automating repetitive IT workflows using Python, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script, and interacting with RESTful APIs.

  • Infrastructure as Code Skills: Practical experience (or strong familiarity) using Terraform to manage SaaS or cloud environments.

  • Security & Identity Focus: Deep understanding of modern identity management, SAML/OIDC protocols, and Zero Trust security architectures (specifically Google’s Context-Aware Access and BeyondCorp models).

  • Chrome Enterprise Management: Proven experience configuring Chrome as a secure enterprise browser, including the deployment of Chrome Enterprise Premium security controls.

  • Analytical & Compliance-Minded: Familiarity with compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC2) and the operational workflows of Google Vault for legal and audit discovery.

  • Collaborative Spirit: Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical requirements into user-friendly solutions for a diverse global team.

Nice to Have

  • Professional Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Collaboration Engineer, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent security certifications.

  • Fintech Experience: Experience working in highly regulated industries (banking, fintech, or healthcare) with stringent data governance requirements.

What’s in it for you:

postings.title: Treasury Trader
postings.description:
About the opportunity

As our new Treasury Trader you will autonomously drive core treasury operations, liquidity and cash management, and investments (with a primary focus on public sector financing). Operating with high autonomy, you will manage the short term Treasury book, central bank operations, assess bank’s liquidity position and monitor key KPIs. Acting as a crucial bridge across Group Risk, Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting, you will also as 1 LoD maintain audit readiness to ensure complete operational stability.

You will also enjoy our hybrid work model - flexibility of working both from home, and from our office in Barcelona. 

In this role, you will:

  • Trade Execution & Portfolio Management: Evaluate potential investment opportunities, then price (Bloomberg experience required), execute, and log transactions across Front Office tools, focusing primarily on public sector financing and short maturities. Proactively manage money market products and the short-term book, including Repo and Reverse Repo portfolios.
  • Liquidity & Reserve Management: Oversee key liquidity functions, including Bundesbank cash pooling, Eurosystem minimum reserve requirements, overnight deposits, credit lines, and short-term portfolio hedging.
  • Payment Systems & Central Bank Operations: Serve as the primary deputy for key payment and settlement infrastructure (Target, ESMIG, MACCS) and oversee central bank account management.
  • Audit, Compliance & Governance: Support internal and external audits, enforce compliance with key banking regulations, and drive First Line of Defense (1LoD) risk management.
  • Product & Tech Initiatives: Lead New Product Process (NPP) implementations, vendor onboarding, core banking system enhancements, and automated reporting solutions using SQL.

 

What you need to be successful:

  • Experience: Strong background in bank treasury operations, liquidity management, and money markets, with a preference for hands-on Repo/Reverse Repo and hedging experience.
  • Technical & System Expertise: Solid familiarity with Treasury Front Office tools (Bloomberg experience required), payment and settlement systems (Target, ESMIG, MACCS), and data querying skills (SQL).
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of financial markets combined with a sound grasp of Eurosystem frameworks, reserve requirements, and key European banking regulations (including MaRisk, CRR III, and KWG).
  • Ownership: Proven ability to drive cross-functional projects, step in as a trusted deputy across core functions, and operate autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

 

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. 
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.    
  • Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.  
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds. 
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

postings.title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Bank Balance
postings.description:
At SumUp, the Global Bank team builds the core infrastructure and services that give merchants a digital bank account, helping small businesses manage their money easily and reliably. 

The Balance Management Squad sits at the core of the Global Bank Platform. Right now, our team is completing a major milestone: consolidating and modernizing our balance management system in Europe. The next big step is creating a global transaction history service; a single, shared platform used by all regions to give merchants consistent and transparent views of their financial activity.

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll help modernize existing systems while balancing innovation with stability, collaborate with teams across regions, and build reliable services that manage diverse markets with different regulations.

If you enjoy solving complex problems on high-load systems, are curious about banking, and are looking for a team that tackles challenges head-on, we’d love to hear from you.

The Vilnius team is a core part of the Global Bank domain. We own production systems, shape technical direction, and work closely with colleagues across SumUp’s global offices on critical merchant banking capabilities. Join our Vilnius Team today (Vilnius office).

What You’ll Do

  • Build and evolve the SumUp’s core banking services that powers ledger operations and transactions, transforming our regional systems into a unified, scalable global platform.
  • Tackle complex distributed systems challenges, ensuring resilient services that continue to perform under high transaction volumes.
  • Support modernization initiatives by improving observability, adding test coverage, refactoring code for long-term maintainability, and gradually introducing new architectural patterns without disrupting live banking operations.
  • Contribute to key architectural decisions - build ledger and transaction history systems from the ground up, ensuring a globally scalable banking solution for our clients.
  • Collaborate with teams across Risk, Treasury, Finance, and Infrastructure to ensure smooth, compliant, and reliable global operations
  • Take ownership from design to production, running the services you build, monitoring their performance, and continuously improving how we deliver high-quality software at scale.

You’ll be great for this role if

  • You have solid backend experience building reliable, high-volume services and you think carefully about system design, APIs, data modeling, and how services interact.
  • You are proficient in Golang and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed, e.g. Kotlin or Elixir.
  • You write maintainable, well-tested code, follow CI/CD best practices, and take responsibility for the software you build from development to production.
  • You’re comfortable building, deploying, and running services in cloud environments like AWS using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • You’re eager to learn about relational databases that perform well under load and maintain data consistency.
  • You are a collaborator who enjoys working across regions, communicating clearly, exchanging feedback effectively, and making thoughtful technical decisions together.
  • You have a curiosity for building reliable financial services and banking domain

It’s a plus if you have

  • Knowledge of Elixir - some of our legacy services are written in Elixir, and while it's not essential, it would be useful if you've worked with it before
  • Deeper PostgreSQL experience - we rely heavily on Postgres, so if you've done performance tuning, complex queries, or schema design, that's a plus
  • Experience with event streaming platforms (Kafka preferred) and modern observability stacks (Grafana, Honeycomb, etc.)

Why you should join SumUp 

🌎 We’re a truly global team of 3200+ skilled professionals from 92+ countries, spread across 4 continents. Join the team from our Vilnius office.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced.

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success

🏥 Peace of mind: health insurance through Gjensidige and life & accidental coverage from Ergo

postings.title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Transfers Europe
postings.description:
At SumUp, we empower small businesses with simple, affordable tools to start, run, and grow. Our Global Bank teams build the financial services that help merchants manage their money and keep their businesses moving.

For merchants, a transfer should feel simple. Behind that experience is a complex network of payment schemes, banks, providers, messages, certificates, reconciliations, and edge cases—all of which need to work together reliably.

Transfers Europe squad is the integration layer connecting SumUp’s internal systems with the financial networks that move money across Europe and the UK. We build and run the backend services behind SEPA and UK transfer flows, helping move money accurately and reliably across external networks.

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll take ownership of services that process real money. You’ll work on complex systems problems to ensure seamless integrations as we scale, while seeing a direct connection between your engineering decisions and merchant trust.

If you enjoy understanding how systems behave under real-world conditions while improving them over time, we’d love to hear from you.

Our tech stack includes Golang, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kubernetes, supported by a strong observability toolchain with Prometheus, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We also actively use AI‑assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others.

What you’ll do 

  • Build and maintain production money movement backend services, contributing to their delivery, observability, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Own and deliver well‑defined tasks and features, and contribute to larger projects within the team’s domain.
  • Contribute to technical design and implementation, following established architectural patterns and best practices.
  • Improve service reliability and quality by writing tests, enhancing monitoring, and following established delivery pipelines.
  • Support the operation of the systems you work on by participating in on‑call rotations, incident response, and learning from post‑incident reviews.
  • Apply a backend and systems perspective during refinement, raising questions about risks, dependencies, and edge cases.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and other engineers to deliver end‑to‑end transfer and banking capabilities.

You’ll be great for this role if you

  • Have experience building backend services in a modern environment and supporting them in production.
  • You are proficient in Golang and and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed
  • Are comfortable working with cloud‑based systems, containerized workloads, and automated delivery pipelines.
  • Raise well-scoped pull requests, conduct thorough code reviews, and help maintain high standards of code quality and test coverage across the team
  • Understand the fundamentals of system architecture, data modelling, and API design, and are eager to deepen this knowledge.
  • Are curious about how your work fits into the broader system and product experience.
  • Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.

Any of the following would be considered a plus

  • Exposure to banking, payments, or financial systems, especially in regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting systems with production traffic, including participating in incident response.
  • Use of AI‑assisted tools to improve development speed, learning, or code quality.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

The team is growing its software engineering capabilities to develop Sentinel, our entity-level investigation and actioning framework, and to support broader risk and compliance use cases.

You will bring dedicated backend expertise to the team. We value pragmatic engineering, thoughtful collaboration and the ability to balance delivery speed with security, reliability and long-term maintainability. Most of our codebase is written in Go, but we are open to candidates who have solid backend experience with other language(s) and are willing to pick up Go on the job. You will collaborate with great Go engineers in the tribe and you will be able to learn from them.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Develop new functionality and support existing services across the tribe’s codebase, primarily using Go.
  • Contribute to the continued development of our in-house merchant risk decision framework, taking it beyond its MVP and enabling new fraud prevention, risk and compliance use cases.
  • Design, build and maintain reliable distributed systems and backend services.
  • Work closely with product managers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, fraud strategy teams and operational stakeholders to turn complex problems into practical solutions.
  • Help shape technical direction, service boundaries and system design decisions across the team.
  • Contribute to Python projects, including AI-agent initiatives, as you build a broader understanding of the team’s systems.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, monitoring and continuous improvement of production services.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to deliver meaningful features faster without compromising code quality, security or maintainability.
  • Be open to participating in an on-call rotation as the team’s production responsibilities and support model evolve.

 

You’ll be great for this role if you have:

  • Professional experience developing backend software in Go or another language such as Java, C or C++; you’re motivated to learn and work with Go.
  • Experience building and operating distributed systems and backend services
  • Strong system design skills and an understanding of reliable, maintainable software architecture.
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and Kafka
  • Working knowledge of Python and/or an interest in contributing to Python-based products or AI/agentic development
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools as part of your software development workflow
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams and collaborating with stakeholders beyond engineering
  • A pragmatic, outcome-focused approach: you know how to define a valuable MVP, make sensible trade-offs and improve solutions iteratively
  • A collaborative mindset and the confidence to challenge ideas constructively while remaining open to feedback
  • Motivation to learn about fintech, fraud prevention, risk and compliance domains

In the Global Bank tribe, we are building the infrastructure and core services needed to provide our merchants with a digital bank account that empowers them to be successful at doing what they love. Our goal is to become the most popular banking partner for small merchants globally by offering a high-quality banking experience tailored to their needs - effortless, simple, and affordable.

Joining the Global Bank tribe means playing a key role in helping us build SumUp's digital bank. You’ll collaborate with a global, autonomous, cross-functional team that refines an aspect of our product from concept to execution. Work alongside colleagues from 32 nationalities across Cologne, Berlin, São Paulo, Sofia, London and Vilnius, united by a shared commitment to taking ownership, working with purpose, and helping small businesses thrive.

As a Backend Engineer, you'll be responsible for evolving and maintaining a high-throughput banking ecosystem for merchants inside our Global Bank Tribe. You’ll play a key role in architecting and evolving our global banking platform; ensuring high availability, scalability, and observability across multiple regions. If you'd like to gain experience building business accounts, card payment, and transfers products etc, across Europe and Latam for SumUp's Global Bank, join us and be part of this exciting journey!

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with a global team to design and build a unified global banking platform. This includes high-level APIs for multiple regions and local implementations, ensuring high availability and observability
  • Be part of the transformation team that is transforming monolithic services into decoupled, highly scalable, region-agnostic, unified global bank services
  • Design, implement, and iteratively develop highly available backend services, while continuously evaluating and implementing new methods to ensure the high reliability of transfer systems
  • Maintain and improve core services utilizing a modern, cloud-native technology stack (AWS, K8s), with microservices written in Golang, Kotlin and Java and Elixir.

  • Shape and continuously improve our engineering culture by sharing ideas, refining best practices, exploring innovative solutions, and contributing to comprehensive documentation and tool selection.

You’ll be great for this role if 

  • Solid programming experience and interest in working in any of these modern languages (Java, Kotlin, Golang and Elixir).

  • You have experience with modern cloud technologies like AWS, and containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Votre rémunération

postings.title: Consultor de Ventas - Autonomo
postings.description:
Consultor de Ventas

Sobre nosotros

Los grandes vendedores no esperan oportunidades, las crean.

Buscamos perfiles orientados a resultados, con mentalidad comercial fuerte y ganas de construir algo propio mientras ayudan a los pequeños negocios a crecer.

Las pymes y comercios en España son la base de nuestra economía y necesitan una plataforma de pagos y gestión financiera diseñada para su realidad. Eso es exactamente lo que ofrece SumUp, y estamos ampliando nuestro equipo comercial para llegar a negocios en todo el país.

Descripción del rol

Buscamos un Consultor de Ventas para desarrollar negocio en tu territorio asignado.

Estarás en contacto directo con propietarios de pequeños y medianos negocios, ayudándoles a descubrir cómo las soluciones de pago y gestión financiera de SumUp pueden mejorar su operativa diaria.

Este es un rol para personas que disfrutan vendiendo cara a cara, generando sus propias oportunidades y construyendo relaciones comerciales sólidas.

Desde el primer día tendrás autonomía para desarrollar tu mercado, construir tu pipeline y cerrar acuerdos.

Qué harás

  • Identificar y captar nuevos clientes, especialmente pequeños y medianos negocios.

  • Generar oportunidades comerciales mediante prospección, networking y puerta fría.

  • Realizar reuniones presenciales y demostraciones de producto.

  • Explicar el valor de las soluciones de pago y gestión financiera de SumUp.

  • Construir y gestionar tu propio pipeline comercial.

  • Gestionar objeciones y cerrar acuerdos de forma efectiva.

  • Crear relaciones de confianza a largo plazo con los comercios de tu cartera.

  • Alcanzar y superar objetivos comerciales de forma constante.

Encajarás si...

  • Tienes experiencia en ventas B2B, Field Sales o desarrollo de negocio.

  • Has trabajado generando tus propias oportunidades comerciales.

  • Tienes experiencia en prospección, generación de leads y construcción de pipeline.

  • Estás acostumbrado a trabajar por objetivos.

  • Conoces bien el tejido empresarial local y los retos de los pequeños negocios.

  • Te sientes cómodo vendiendo cara a cara y desarrollando relaciones comerciales.

  • Eres autónomo, resiliente y orientado a resultados.

Por qué unirte a SumUp

  • Bonus mensual de 500€ sujeto a Partner Status.

  • 50% de los ingresos generados por pagos, hardware y software.

  • 20% de ingreso recurrente sobre tu cartera durante dos años.

  • Potencial de generar ingresos recurrentes a largo plazo.

  • Formación práctica en producto, ventas y desarrollo comercial.

  • Acompañamiento continuo por parte de un Territory Manager.

  • Libertad para gestionar tu territorio y desarrollar tu propio negocio.

Diversidad e inclusión

En SumUp creemos que la diversidad impulsa la innovación. Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y valoramos a todas las personas independientemente de su origen, género, identidad de género, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

SumUp no acepta currículums no solicitados de agencias externas. Las candidaturas deben enviarse directamente por los propios candidatos.

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

postings.description:
About the team:

At SumUp, keeping our platform safe and compliant is critical to the trust of the millions of small businesses we serve around the world.

You’ll join our Global AML team at an exciting point in its growth. We’re expanding into new markets, evolving our AML capabilities, introducing AI-enabled controls, and navigating increasingly complex regulatory expectations.

As an AML Data Analyst, you’ll play a key role in turning AML data into actionable insights. Working closely with our global AML Operations and AML Governance teams, as well as colleagues across Engineering and Data, you’ll help us understand how our controls are performing, identify risks and gaps early, and make better decisions as our business scales.

This is a role where your analysis will go beyond reporting. The insights you generate will directly support how we monitor, improve, and strengthen our global AML framework.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Build and maintain AML dashboards, operational reports, and data packs used by AML Operations, AML Governance, and senior leadership
  • Design measurement frameworks that track AML operational KPIs, including case volumes, productivity, SLA adherence, and screening hit rates
  • Support AML teams by providing data extracts, analysis, trend identification, and root-cause analysis on AML control outputs and data quality issues
  • Run data validation and quality checks to keep AML data accurate and consistent across systems and regions
  • Support Transaction Monitoring and Sanctions/PEP screening through data analysis, requirements definition, and testing
  • Partner with Engineering and AML Operations to define data requirements and support automation projects
  • Build self-service analytics resources so AML Operations teams can explore data and find insights independently

 

You’ll be great for this role if you have:

  • Experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role within financial services, fintech, compliance, AML, or another regulated environment.
  • Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries and building reliable datasets for reporting and analysis.
  • Practical experience with Python for data analysis and automation.
  • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify patterns, trends, root causes, and actionable insights from complex data.
  • The ability to translate technical analysis into clear recommendations and stories for non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Experience working with data quality, validation, multiple data sources, and competing stakeholder priorities.
  • A proactive, curious mindset and interest in AML, financial crime, fintech, and emerging technologies such as AI, with the ability to take ownership in a fast-changing environment.

postings.title: Fraud Prevention Specialist
postings.description:
Fraud Prevention Strategy Specialist

Fraud Prevention team · Berlin, Germany (office-first)

SumUp's Fraud Prevention team sits at the intersection of risk, data and global payments, working at pace to stay ahead of one of fintech's most dynamic challenges: stopping fraud at scale across multiple markets and products. In this role, you'll help protect SumUp's acquiring business globally, using data, analytical thinking and fraud prevention expertise to reduce losses while safeguarding approval rates and the experience of our merchants and their customers. You'll work on complex, high impact fraud challenges across international markets, building a deep understanding of fraud performance and turning your analysis into practical strategies that shape how we prevent fraud over time.

What you'll do

  • Shape fraud prevention strategy for SumUp's acquiring business across international markets
  • Analyse large, complex datasets to spot fraud trends, performance shifts and opportunities for improvement
  • Design, configure and test decision engine rules, thresholds and authentication strategies
  • Monitor fraud, chargeback, approval rate and false positive performance to assess strategy effectiveness
  • Investigate root causes of performance changes and recommend clear, evidence based actions
  • Translate regulatory and card scheme requirements into practical fraud controls

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Proven experience in fraud prevention, fraud strategy or risk management within payments, fintech or another data driven environment
  • Advanced skills in SQL and Python, including experience working with data pipelines and large datasets
  • Hands on experience configuring fraud decision engines, rule based systems or authentication strategies
  • Strong knowledge of Card Present and Card Not Present fraud patterns across diverse markets, with the ability to apply this knowledge to strategy
  • Ability to balance merchant conversion, approval rates, fraud losses and false positives when making decisions, and to communicate recommendations clearly to technical and senior stakeholders

It would be a plus if you have

  • Participation in industry working groups, webinars or communities focused on global fraud trends
  • Knowledge of acquirer settlement flows and interchange economics
  • Experience working with card scheme requirements or regulatory change across international payments markets

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🎁 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. postings.description:
SumUp gives small businesses the tools they need to get paid, manage their money, and grow - today, over 4 million merchants across 37 markets worldwide rely on SumUp to do exactly that.

The Bank Web squad sits within SumUp's Banking domain and owns the web experience across our banking surfaces - from the business account dashboard that merchants use daily, to the back-office tooling that powers the support teams behind them. The team has a clear mission: make Bank Web a genuinely first-class platform, on par with our mobile applications in quality, reliability, and performance.

Joining now means being part of a team that’s at a key growth point - modernization work, growing scope across markets, and making architectural decisions that will shape how millions of merchants experience SumUp's banking products.

👉 Take a look at our Sofia office

What you'll do

  • Build and own features end-to-end across our web banking surfaces - from scoping and component implementation through testing, observability, and production maintenance
  • Work across the full stack - including defining API contracts, working with backend proxies, and integrating with the services that power our banking platform
  • Contribute to modernisation efforts, including architectural improvements, component refactoring, and stack migrations that reduce technical debt and accelerate future delivery
  • Review peers' pull requests with attention to UI consistency, accessibility, and frontend best practices
  • Participate in production support and incident reviews, helping to strengthen the squad's operational resilience across its web domain

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Strong experience with React, TypeScript, with a track record of delivering production-ready features end-to-end -not just isolated UI components
  • Genuine full-stack capability: Experience defining API contracts, working with backend proxies, and owning integrations, not just consuming them; backend experience in Node, Kotlin, Java, or Golang is valued
  • Solid understanding of frontend architecture, component design patterns, state management, and how frontend applications connect to backend services
  • Experience writing and maintaining frontend tests (unit, integration, snapshot, end-to-end) and a genuine care for code quality and reliability
  • Comfort navigating a complex, multi-stack codebase. React and TypeScript are core to this role, while our broader ecosystem also includes Node.js, Kotlin, Java, Go, Angular, AWS and Kafka. Prior experience with all of these is not required, but familiarity with most of them is a plus
  • Curiosity about complex domains - banking products have intricate user flows and edge cases, and you enjoy digging into them to find the right solution
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and getting changes safely to production; exposure to AI tooling to augment engineering workflows is a plus

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our modern Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup
  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

We believe in the everyday hero. Those who have the courage to follow their passion and who have the strength and determination to realise their dreams.

Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their businesses. Global Process Owner - Finance

📍 Sofia, Bulgaria

About the team

If you're a finance professional who thinks in processes and speaks the language of data and systems, this role was built for you.

You'll own the end-to-end accounting processes behind SumUp's core financial products: payments, banking, and lending. It's a role where finance meets technology and analytics — and where your ability to bridge these worlds will have a direct impact on how SumUp scales globally.

This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence, reporting directly to the VP of Finance Operations.

🎥 Get a feel for our Sofia office: Sofia

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end design and continuous improvement of accounting processes for payments, banking, and lending
  • Work with large, complex datasets to identify process gaps, reconciliation issues, and automation opportunities
  • Collaborate closely with finance and business stakeholders to ensure accounting processes scale and adapt with the business
  • Act as the finance domain expert in conversations with Systems Architects, ERP, and product teams — ensuring accounting logic is reflected in how our SAP S/4HANA and SAP FICO systems are built and integrated
