postings.title: Head of Consumer Growth
postings.description:
Head of Consumer Growth

SumUp is building a consumer financial product with a distribution advantage that almost no other fintech can replicate.

More than four million merchants use SumUp, and more than a billion consumers come into contact with our products each year. We now have the opportunity to turn that reach into one of the world’s largest consumer financial ecosystems.

Our consumer product is already live across six European markets. The next challenge is to grow it from an emerging proposition into a product used by millions of consumers and this role will lead that journey.

As Head of Consumer Growth, you will own the go-to-market strategy, commercial growth plan and acquisition engine for SumUp’s consumer product. You will build the consumer growth function from its current early stage, bringing together performance marketing, direct-to-consumer acquisition, merchant-led distribution, CRM, creative and content.

You will combine proven consumer growth channels with an opportunity unique to SumUp: turning our merchant network and consumer touchpoints into a powerful new route to market. From paid acquisition, referrals and lifecycle marketing to receipts, payment screens, merchant communications and in-store experiences, you will determine how SumUp reaches, converts and retains millions of consumers.

Our ambition goes beyond building another successful consumer finance product. By connecting consumers and merchants within the same ecosystem, we can change the economics of payments. The more consumers who choose to pay with SumUp, the closer we move towards our long-term ambition of eliminating transaction fees for businesses around the world.

What you’ll do

  • Own the go-to-market strategy and growth plan for SumUp’s consumer product across six European markets.
  • Build and lead a multidisciplinary consumer growth team spanning performance marketing, merchant-led acquisition, direct-to-consumer marketing, CRM, design and content.
  • Develop a balanced acquisition model that combines proven consumer growth channels with SumUp’s unique merchant network and consumer touchpoints.
  • Take commercial ownership of growth investment, including channel mix, acquisition cost, incentives, promotions, attribution and forecasting.
  • Establish a rigorous test-and-learn programme, turning successful experiments into repeatable playbooks that can scale across markets.
  • Own the consumer GTM roadmap, ensuring product launches, propositions and campaigns are coordinated across channels and markets.
  • Partner closely with Product, Brand, Communications and SumUp’s wider GTM organisation to sharpen the proposition, improve conversion and activate relevant channels across the business.
  • Represent consumer growth in leadership discussions, bringing clarity to performance, investment decisions and the trade-offs required to scale.

You’ll be great for this role if you have

  • A strong track record of leading full-funnel growth for a consumer fintech, neobank, financial services product or high-growth consumer app.
  • Experience scaling a consumer proposition across multiple markets and through a comparable stage of growth.
  • Deep expertise in acquisition strategy, channel mix, attribution, customer acquisition cost, lifecycle growth and unit economics.
  • Experience building and leading multidisciplinary growth teams while remaining comfortable operating hands-on.
  • Strong commercial judgement and a track record of making effective investment decisions under uncertainty.
  • The ability to work across Product, Brand, Analytics, Communications and local market teams within a complex organisation.
  • A rigorous experimentation mindset and the ability to operate quickly and pragmatically in an early-stage environment.
  • Familiarity with financial services marketing regulations and the judgement to work within them without losing creativity or pace.

This is an opportunity to build more than a marketing team. You will create the growth model for a consumer financial product with the potential to operate at global scale, turn one of the world’s largest merchant networks into a powerful distribution channel, and help SumUp build a new payments ecosystem that works better for consumers and businesses around the world.

 

Why you should join SumUp

postings.title: Head of Pricing & Monetisation
postings.description:
Pricing and monetisation sits at the centre of SumUp's commercial engine, shaping how millions of small businesses choose and buy our products, and how we capture value from every product we build. This is a rare opportunity to build senior ownership of pricing to design the operating model, governance and tooling that turn pricing into a repeatable engine for revenue and margin, with a fast route from insight to decision to impact.  Working shoulder to shoulder with Product, Finance, Sales and Engineering, this person will have the space to define the team, the strategy and the way pricing decisions get made across the business.

What you'll do

  • Set a company wide pricing and monetisation strategy, translating commercial priorities into a clear, prioritised roadmap with measurable outcomes attached
  • Own or facilitate pricing decisions across merchant pricing, payment processing economics and packaging, working within agreed decision rights
  • Establish pricing governance, decision rights and escalation paths, creating consistent ways of working across Commercial, Product, Finance, Sales and Engineering
  • Use data, customer insight, financial analysis and experimentation to identify and prioritise the pricing opportunities with the biggest commercial impact
  • Improve how pricing changes move from decision to implementation and measurement, closing gaps and removing bottlenecks along the way
  • Shape pricing data, tooling and experimentation capabilities so teams across the business can make repeatable, evidence-led decisions
  • Build trusted relationships with executive leadership and senior stakeholders across Product, Finance, Sales, Commercial and Engineering

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Extensive senior experience leading pricing, monetisation or commercial strategy in a B2B, fintech, payments, marketplace or platform business, with real accountability for outcomes
  • Strong understanding of packaging and monetisation, with experience defining how products, features and pricing work together to drive adoption, upsell, and customer value growth.
  • Strong track record connecting pricing decisions to revenue, gross margin, contribution margin or other measurable commercial outcomes across products or markets
  • Comfort working with imperfect or fragmented data, building clear value hypotheses and moving from analysis into decisions and measurable execution
  • Experience setting pricing strategy, governance and decision rights across multiple stakeholder groups, including building, leading or significantly developing a pricing or monetisation team
  • Confident, clear communication style with the ability to influence Product, Finance, Sales, Commercial and Engineering stakeholders, especially when pricing authority is shared across functions

postings.title: Information Security Architect
postings.description:
Office first

Team description

SumUp's Information Security team protects a payments platform used by millions of small businesses, which means the work here directly shapes whether merchants can trust us with their money every single day. As an Information Security Architect, you'll help decide how security gets built into new products from day one, from mobile payments to the secure use of AI, while also stepping in as a senior responder when things go wrong. It's a role that sits at the intersection of prevention and response: you'll shape the architecture that stops incidents from happening, and you'll be in the room leading the response when they do anyway.

What you'll do

  • Define security architecture requirements for high-risk initiatives, including PCI PIN, payment processing, and mobile payment surfaces
  • Build automation for security architecture assurance and incident response, such as policy-as-code, detection-as-code, and SOAR workflows
  • Lead incident triage, investigation, containment, and remediation for complex, high-severity security incidents
  • Develop and improve incident response playbooks and detection automation with the wider security team
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Platform, IT, Product, Risk, and Compliance to validate security before launch
  • Maintain a prioritised security roadmap that balances architecture work with lessons learned from incidents

You'll be great for this role if…

  • More than 8 years of security experience, typically including at least three years focused on security architecture and substantial hands-on incident response
  • Strong knowledge of SIEM/SOAR/CNAPP systems
  • Experience working with modern Cloud vendors (AWS/AZURE/GCP) & SaaS solutions (Vercel, n8n, Cloudflare, Langdock, Cursor, IncidentIO, Notion, Vanta)
  • Strong knowledge of payment security standards, including PCI DSS and PCI PIN
  • Experience building or improving detection as code, security automation pipelines, or workflow automation tools
  • Comfort translating architecture decisions and incident risk into clear language for senior stakeholders
  • Track record of leading response during high-severity incidents while balancing multiple cross-functional priorities

postings.title: iOS Engineer - Design System
postings.description:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

 

You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
  • Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
  • Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
  • Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
  • Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
  • Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
  • Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

postings.description:
Transforme o comércio local e faça parte de um time global que acredita no poder dos empreendedores!

Sobre a SumUp

Na SumUp, nossa missão é empoderar pequenos empreendedores com soluções inovadoras que simplificam a gestão do dia a dia e potencializam seus negócios. Com mais de 4 milhões de comerciantes confiando em nossas soluções, oferecemos tecnologia de ponta em leitores de cartão, software de ponto de venda, gestão de inventário, análise empresarial e muito mais. Queremos ser o parceiro digital completo para empreendedores que buscam crescer seus negócios.

Sobre a missão e o time

Estamos em busca de talentos apaixonados por vendas e pessoas! Nesta posição, você terá a chance de: Impulsionar o sucesso de pequenos empreendedores, oferecendo soluções de pagamento que realmente fazem a diferença. Criar conexões de impacto com comerciantes, promovendo experiências personalizadas que vão além de um atendimento comum. Fazer parte de um time dinâmico e inovador, com rotinas focadas em resultados e no crescimento mútuo.

Como será o seu “dia a dia”

  • Identificar e engajar clientes de alto potencial na região designada, focando no crescimento de negócios locais;
  • Realizar visitas porta a porta e reuniões presenciais para apresentar os benefícios das soluções avançadas da SumUp;
  • Construir um pipeline robusto por meio de networking, indicações e prospecção ativa;
  • Gerir indicadores, monitorar a carteira de clientes e garantir o pós-venda com foco em retenção;
  • Participar de reuniões matinais para reportar números, acompanhar metas e ajustar estratégias;
  • Garantir um relacionamento próximo e personalizado com os comerciantes.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa que preencha os requisitos abaixo

  • Profissional de vendas talentoso e dinâmico, com habilidade para construir relacionamentos genuínos e se adaptar rapidamente a diferentes situações e contextos;
  • Sabe identificar oportunidades, comunicar valor de forma clara e apresentar soluções de maneira persuasiva;
  • Tem paixão por apoiar pequenos e médios empreendedores, além de demonstrar colaboração e proatividade para superar desafios e alcançar resultados consistentes;
  • É organizado, sabe gerenciar múltiplas demandas e possui excelente comunicação;
  • É motivado por metas, desafios e tem um mindset analítico que impulsiona a melhoria contínua de processos e resultados.

Diferenciais que amamos:

  • Experiência em vendas externas, especialmente em varejo ou soluções de ponto de venda.
  • Histórico comprovado de superar metas e alcançar resultados excepcionais.
  • Graduação completa.


O que você ganha com a gente?

  • Comissão agressiva: Reconhecimento financeiro alinhado ao seu desempenho;
  • Treinamento contínuo: Vamos te preparar para brilhar e alcançar o próximo nível.

 

Benefícios incríveis:

🩺 Plano de Saúde e Odontológico  

🧑‍⚕️Zenklub ( apoio psicológico)

🌀Previdência privada

🥗Vale-refeição/alimentação

🚙Auxílio-transporte

💪Wellhub

🖤Seguro de vida

👪Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 3 meses

🎉Day off no aniversário

🌍O Break 4 Me: é um benefício exclusivo focado na saúde e bem-estar dos SumUppers. Ao completar 3 anos na empresa, você ganha automaticamente 30 dias adicionais de descanso remunerado, além das férias regulares do ano.

Por que escolher a SumUp?

  • Faça parte de um time global com mais de 3.000 pessoas de 40+ países;
  • Trabalhe em um ambiente onde a inovação e o impacto social caminham juntos;
  • Contribua para transformar a vida de pequenos empreendedores e fortalecer o comércio local.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

postings.title: Record to Report Team Leader
postings.description:
Team: Finance – R2R Accounting | Location: Sofia, Bulgaria | Contract type: Permanent, office-first

Take a look inside our Sofia office

 

Team description

Our global Record to Report (R2R) team keeps SumUp's financial reporting accurate and on time across every entity we operate, from payroll and inventory to intercompany transactions and fixed assets. As we hold ourselves to the highest standards in accounting and prepare for the next stage of our growth, this team's work becomes more visible and more critical every year. Leading this team of 16 accountants across Sofia and São Paulo means shaping how a fast-growing, multi-entity business closes its books, and giving the people behind that work the direction and support they need to do it well.

 

What you'll do

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing processes for R2R, keeping financial records accurate, complete, and on time across all SumUp entities
  • Coordinate audit activities and manage the relationship with external auditors to ensure smooth, timely delivery of annual financial statements
  • Drive automation of postings and reconciliations, such as payroll integrations and scripted reconciliations, to free up capacity for higher-value improvements
  • Own the annual stock count process, including the first-time count of field sales inventory
  • Manage and develop a team of 16 accountants across two locations, setting clear goals and building a strong feedback culture
  • Partner with Controlling, Treasury, Tax, Procurement, and People Ops to improve analysis, reconciliation and posting quality and support new business initiatives

 

You'll be great for this role if...

  • Track record of leading a finance or accounting team through a period of growth or significant change
  • ACCA or CIMA member with strong knowledge of IFRS with experience applying accounting standards to complex, judgement-based transactions
  • Experience coordinating audit processes and building relationships with external auditors
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where processes aren't always perfect and improvement is part of the job
  • Fluency in English, with the confidence to explain financial topics clearly to non-finance stakeholders

 

Why you should join SumUp

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our modern Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 and 10 paid days of educational leave which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 

🏖 Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options 

🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance 

💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities 

🍽 Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform 

🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station 

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. postings.title: Software Engineer Java - Payouts Platform
postings.description:
Who We Are:

We’ve come a long way from our origins as a small startup. Today, we’re a truly global fintech company, with over 3000+ people from 80 nationalities, spread across 22 offices on 4 continents. And we’re growing and diversifying faster than ever before.

SumUp enables businesses to get paid easily, process orders quickly, sell online instantly and manage their money more efficiently. We create the tools businesses need to make their business and their customer experience thrive.

The Team:

Our robust payments processing platform, consisting of various sub-platforms, has powered SumUp’s global business for over a decade. A critical component of this platform is our Payouts team, which owns the components responsible for payout profiles and payout scheduling. These systems play a critical role in the wider payout flow: they manage how and when merchants receive their funds and support the configuration needed for reliable payouts across markets.

About the Role:

Payouts are one of the most important parts of the merchant experience. When a merchant expects to receive their money, the process needs to be reliable, transparent and predictable.

In this role, you’ll work on systems that directly support the movement of funds to SumUp merchants. You’ll help modernise existing components, build new capabilities and contribute to a platform that needs to operate reliably across markets and at scale.

This is a role for an engineer who enjoys solving complex backend problems, working with distributed systems and balancing the needs of a legacy platform with the opportunity to build something better.

Our Stack:

Java (minimal setup, Spring Boot), Kafka Streams, PostgreSQL/RDBMS, RestEasy, VueJS.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and maintain the payout profile and payout scheduling components of SumUp’s Payments Processing Platform.
  • Help transition the existing legacy system to a new event-driven microservices architecture.
  • Design and build scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Work across the full software development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to testing, deployment and production support.
  • Build reliable, maintainable and well-tested services that support money movement and merchant payouts.
  • Contribute to API design, data flows and integration patterns across the Payments Platform.
  • Investigate operational issues, identify root causes and implement permanent fixes.
  • Participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews and code reviews.
  • Collaborate with engineers, QA, Product and adjacent Payments teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Help improve the team’s engineering practices, operational readiness and system maintainability.

You will be a great fit if you have:

  • Strong professional experience across the full software development lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience building backend services with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience working with distributed systems and microservices architectures.
  • Understanding of event-driven systems, service integration and reliable data flows.
  • Experience designing, building and maintaining APIs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a structured approach to investigating complex issues.
  • Experience writing production-quality, maintainable and well-tested code.
  • An ownership mindset and willingness to take responsibility for the systems you build and operate.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • The ability to work autonomously while contributing actively to a team environment.
  • A tool-agnostic mindset and the ability to learn new technologies pragmatically.

postings.title: Vendor Operations Performance Analyst
postings.description:
Vendor Operations Performance Analyst

Location: Berlin, Germany (office-first setup )

Employment type: Full-time, permanent

 

Team description

Our Vendor Operations team is the engine that allows SumUp to support millions of merchants worldwide. We partner with external service providers to ensure our global support remains personal, efficient, and high-quality. We don't just manage vendors; we build seamless extensions of the SumUp culture, ensuring every merchant receives world-class service, no matter where they are in the world.

As our Vendor Operations Analyst, you will be the person who keeps our BPO partners performing at their best: day in, day out. You'll own operational performance governance across our outsourced partners: tracking KPIs, running governance cadences, diagnosing performance issues and driving the improvements that keep our vendors consistently accountable to the SumUp standard. You are the link between operational data and real-world results.

What you'll do

  • Track productivity and efficiency KPIs across all outsourcing partners, spot deviations early, and push for corrective action before issues escalate
  • Investigate the root causes behind performance dips, such as productivity drops, rising backlogs, or slipping schedule adherence, and turn findings into clear, prioritised improvement plans
  • Build onboarding and readiness processes so new agents reach full productivity quickly across all partner sites
  • Design and roll out process and tooling improvements in partnership with Business Architecture, Enablement, Change Management, CRM, and Data/BI teams
  • Prepare data driven agendas for vendor business reviews, track agreed actions, and escalate when partners fall short of targets
  • Support vendor negotiations with performance analysis and scenario modelling to improve cost per interaction

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Experience investigating operational underperformance, such as productivity dips, rising backlogs, schedule adherence issues and turning findings into clear, prioritised, improvement plans.
  • Track record of documenting and standardising operational processes so they're clear, repeatable and easy for other teams to follow and maintain.
  • Comfort coordinating improvement projects across multiple internal teams, such as workforce management, enablement and data teams. Managing dependencies and keeping stakeholders aligned without formal authority.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and experience with CRM or BI platforms (such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Tableau, or Looker) to pull data independently and build operational performance reports.
  • Background in a BPO or outsourced operations environment, with hands on experience supporting vendor performance governance and KPI tracking.

postings.description:
About the team:

At SumUp, we’re passionate about supporting small businesses. We believe everyone should have access to flexible, fair, and easy-to-use technology that helps bring their ideas to life. Every day, millions of people around the world dream of starting their own business—and we’re here to help make that happen. Our long-term ambition is to "close the loop" by turning everyday transactions into lasting relationships between businesses and their customers.

As part of our People Tech team, our mission is to enable long-term scalability by fostering a data-informed culture through seamless systems and a people-centric employee experience.

In this role, reporting to the Head of People Tech, you’ll work at the heart of our Workday ecosystem. You’ll collaborate closely with People Operations, Payroll, and business stakeholders to ensure our Workday HCM setup remains scalable, reliable, and intuitive as we grow.

Rather than simply maintaining the system, you’ll help shape how our employee lifecycle processes are designed, configured, and continuously improved — ensuring Workday supports both operational excellence and a seamless experience for SumUppers.

 

What you'll do:

  • Configure and enhance Workday’s Core HCM module to ensure our processes are scalable, consistent, and easy to navigate.
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business needs into thoughtful system design — improving workflows, automation, and data quality.
  • Strengthen document generation, validation logic, and reporting structures to reduce manual work and prevent downstream errors.
  • Provide responsive and empathetic guidance to SumUppers using Workday, helping them feel confident and supported.
  • Build and maintain reliable reports and dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and supporting informed decision-making.
  • Contribute to clear documentation, structured change management, and sustainable configuration standards.

 

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday HCM Core (experience with additional modules such as Time Tracking or Compensation is a plus).
  • A solid understanding of Workday fundamentals such as Staffing, Worker Data, Organizations, Business Processes, and Reporting.
  • Confidence working with structured datasets to validate configuration changes and ensure reliable outputs.
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills and attention to data accuracy.
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and translate business needs into scalable system solutions.
  • A mindset that looks for simplification, standardisation, and continuous improvement.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

postings.title: Software Engineer
postings.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, world-class customer service isn’t an afterthought, it’s at the heart of everything we do. We’ve built our reputation on delivering fast, thoughtful, and high-quality support, and we’ve done that by investing deeply in our own technology. Rather than just reacting to problems, we aim to solve them before our customers and partners even notice. Behind the scenes, that means building systems that scale globally, handle real-world complexity, and empower support teams to do their very best work.
This is where the Multilingual Intelligence & Resolution Automation (MIRA) team comes in. The team is on a mission to make customer support truly borderless. We’re building intelligent, AI-powered systems used across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo, including a real-time translation engine that supports seamless conversations across 20+ languages. Processing hundreds of requests per minute and powered by modern cloud infrastructure and state-of-the-art LLMs, this system enables borderless support and helps create experiences that feel natural, human, and native, no matter where you are in the world. And we’re only just getting started.
What you’ll be doing
  • Design, build, and operate scalable backend services powering real-time, customer-facing systems
  • Develop and evolve AI-powered translation capabilities using LLMs in production
  • Help build the tooling and infrastructure needed to evaluate models across quality, latency, and cost
  • Collaborate closely with product, applied science, frontend, and platform teams to turn complex support problems into robust user-facing systems
  • Take ownership of technical decisions and help shape the architecture and future direction of the system
  • Improve the performance, reliability, and operational readiness of services handling real production traffic
  • Continuously explore better ways of working, including leveraging AI tools to improve development workflows
Our humble expectations
  •  You have strong backend development skills in Python or Go (interest in other tech is highly appreciated)
  •  You actively leverage modern AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT or similar) to enhance your productivity, code quality, and day-to-day development workflow.
  •  You have experience with cloud platforms (AWS or similar), container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), observability tools (such as DataDog), and database technologies (SQL and NoSQL).
  •  You're a pragmatic problem-solver with a growth mindset, eager to step outside your comfort zone and continuously learn.
  •  You're comfortable working with real-world data and its nuances.
  •  You have solid experience designing, building, and integrating quality software (microservices) at scale within a complex domain.
What we offer
  • A chance to build something that truly matters, technology that enables people to connect and solve problems across languages and borders
  • The opportunity to work with AI and LLMs in real, high-impact production use cases
  • Being part of a global engineering organization of 2000+ people, we aim to build none other than the best-in-the-world engineering team here.
  • You’ll get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognise that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind, and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join the Wolt AdTech & Promotions team.

This role is best suited for someone who is strongly backend-oriented, thrives in ambiguity, and can take ownership of large, cross-functional initiatives from planning to delivery.

You might be a great fit if you

  • Are a strong backend engineer, ideally with Golang experience
  • Have experience building and operating scalable backend systems
  • Are comfortable working in high-ambiguity environments and bringing structure where needed
  • Can independently lead large initiatives across team boundaries, from problem definition and planning to stakeholder alignment and on-time delivery
  • Communicate clearly and effectively, and know how to gather, process, and act on feedback
  • Can build strong working relationships with stakeholders and keep multiple parties aligned around shared goals
  • Have hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows, including tools like Codex, Claude, and agent-based development approaches
  • Bring experience with NoSQL databases such as Cassandra, MongoDB, or similar technologies

Requirements

  • Backend engineering experience
  • Strong preference for Golang
  • Proven ability to take ownership of complex, cross-team projects in ambiguous environments
  • Strong stakeholder management, planning, and delivery skills
  • Excellent communication and alignment-building skills
  • Extensive experience with AI-assisted development, including tools such as Codex, Claude, and agentic workflows
  • Experience with NoSQL databases such as Cassandra, MongoDB, or similar is a plus

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

postings.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Our Wolt Workplace team runs our offices, to ensure our workplaces’ functionality, comfort, safety, sustainability and efficiency. Our Workplace Coordinator in-country ensure that our offices are properly set up for collaboration and focus as well as ensuring that workplace programs cater to a diverse population of onsite and remote employees. Workplace is a part of the wider Real Estate & Facilities teams and in partnership with the wider team we aim to remove any and all friction in the physical space that prevents our employees from being their most successful. 

You’ll be responsible for the Workplace Experience and Operations for a specific country, running things on the ground and creating functional and efficient workplaces for our offices, employees and guests. 

Role background

Wolt is looking for an experienced Workplace Coordinator who will report to the Regional Workplace Lead, North and work out of our Tallinn Office. You will help shape our workplace experience and run operations. The person in this position must be a creative problem solver; adept at handling multiple tasks concurrently. Combining People, Technology, and Space across to create an exceptional workplace experience for our Employees, Visitors and Contractors whilst ensuring an optimal use of resources. You will need to possess the ability to take thoughtful initiative and the desire to go above and beyond.   • Ensure that enterprise product strategy and architecture strategy match, reinforce each other, and drive business value. This includes shaping the enterprise's AI adoption strategy - identifying where AI creates measurable leverage. Strike the right balance between long-term elegance, enterprise scalability, and short-term pragmatism.
  • Provide authoritative architectural and technical guidance to senior stakeholders and the broader Tech area. Define and enforce enterprise-wide engineering standards, best practices, and architectural guardrails.
  • Lead the design of complex, multi-domain systems. Actively participate in high-stakes architectural discussions, utilizing prototypes and proofs-of-concept to validate enterprise-level solutions before widespread rollout.
  • Drive the department's overarching technical roadmap. Evaluate the current tech portfolio, manage technical debt at an organizational level, and guide "build vs. buy" decisions.

  • Have comprehensive experience spanning Backend/APIs, Frontend/JS, System Design, and DevOps. Understand how these domains interact at a macroeconomic scale.
